subject: English
guide_solution: Paragraph writing Renewable Energy There are two major types of energy sources : renewable and non-renewable. The non-renewable energy sources have always been a major factor of change throughout history. Countries of the world rely heavily on petroleum, coal and natural gas for their energy sources. The world’s petroleum consumption has increased. These are going to be finished very soon. So renewable energy sources such as, wind and solar energy are constantly and naturally replenished and never run short. Most renewable energy comes either directly or indirectly from the sun. Sunlight or solar energy can be used for heating and lighting homes, for generating electricity and for other commercial and First Paper  Solutions industrial uses. The sun’s heat can be captured with wind turbines to produce electricity. Plants produce bio-mass which can be turned into fuels such as fire wood, alcohol, etc identified as bio-energy. Hydrogen can be burned as a fuel to produce electricity. Our earth’s interior heat inside can be tapped as geothermal energy to produce electricity, for heating home, etc. Ocean energy can be used to produce energy.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 122 — National Ideal School, Dhaka

subject: English
guide_solution: Story writing There was a notorious robber in a certian village. He killed many innocent people and took away their belongings. But the villagers did not dare to tell him anything. At last he became old and wanted to stop robbery. He went to a famous hermit and requested him to turn him into a good person. In reply the hermit said "robbery is a great sin and nobody respects a robber." "How can I give it up?" "All right", said the hermit. "Follow this simple advice then : Do not tell a lie." The robber promised that he would not tell a lie from that day. At night the robber went out to rob as usual. On the way a man asked him, "Where are you going?" The robber remembered the advice of the hermit. So he could not tell a lie. He also could not speak the truth. So, he came back home. The same thing happened to the robber every night. Consequently, he gave up the habit of robbery. And finally became a good person.  Title : Truthfulness is a great virtue.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 122 — National Ideal School, Dhaka
